text.body: || lakṣmīnārāyaṇastotram|| śrīnivāsa jagannātha śrīhare bhaktavatsala| lakṣmīpate namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||1|| rādhāramaṇa goviṃda bhaktakāmaprapūraka nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||2|| dāmodara mahodāra sarvāpattinivāraṇa| hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||3|| garuḍadhvaja vaikuṃṭhanivāsinkeśavācyuta| janārdana namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||4|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhara śrīvatsalāṃchana| meghaśyāma namastubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||5|| tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ pitā baṃdhuḥ sadgurustvaṃ dayānidhiḥ| tvatto'nyo na paro devastrāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||6|| na jāne dānadharmādi yogaṃ yāgaṃ tapo japam| tvaṃ kevalaṃ kuru dayāṃ trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt||7|| na matsamo yadyapi pāpakartā na tvatsamo'thāpi hi pāpahartā| vijñāpitaṃ tvetadaśeṣasākṣin māmuddharārtaṃ patitaṃ tavāgre||8|| || iti śrīvāsudevānandasarasvatīviracitaṃ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇastotram saṃpūrṇam ||
